summary: 1935 CCC lookout complex in Otero County with an 80-foot Aermotor MC-39 tower; restored 2010-2012, NRHP-listed 1988, cabin rental planned, road gated.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor MC-39 steel tower with a 7 by 7 foot steel cab, plus an observer's cabin and tool shed

access.note: Forest Service page (updated February 19, 2025) marks the site Site Open, but the road to the lookout is gated and closed; the area is reached on foot.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the 2020 report give 1935 for the complex. The Forest Service dates the tower's erection to 1934 and the observer's cabin and shed to 1935, which explains the one-year gap.
The register uses Carrisa; the Forest Service and the 2020 report use Carrissa; the National Register nomination misspelled it Carissa, which the 2020 report calls a mistake.

notes_for_editor: Current access comes from the Forest Service page last updated February 19, 2025: the site is marked Site Open, the road is gated and closed, and the Forest Service says the site is being converted soon to a cabin rental site. Facts.access is set to restricted. No recreation.gov or later rental listing was found, so please check before publishing. The record's restored 2011 event conflicts with the 2020 report (began 2010, completed 2012); events here use 2010 and 2012. The 1932 and 1958 newspaper items come through the Forest Lookouts transcription; their spellings vary (Carisso, Carrizo, Carizozo), so the link to this tower is not certain. The 1934 tower date from the Forest Service differs from the register's 1935; both are reported. Height 24.4 m is the 80 ft tower height from the register. Current staffing is unknown.
